confidence_rationale: The foundational formalisation of neuromodulator-carried uncertainty signals that set inferential gains, and the direct ancestor of the framework ARC-052's notes invoke. It is theory synthesising others' physiological, pharmacological and behavioural data rather than new measurement, so source_quality is capped below an empirical paper of equal standing. Mapping fidelity is good for the architectural shape (modulator-set precision gains) but imperfect on the specific modulators: the paper assigns the roles to acetylcholine and norepinephrine, while ARC-052 names serotonin and norepinephrine.
failure_signatures: The two uncertainty signals are described as 'part-antagonistic, part-synergistic', so a naive implementation that multiplies independent modulator gains onto a single precision term will mis-model their interaction.

The framework distinguishes EXPECTED uncertainty (known unreliability of a cue within a context) from UNEXPECTED uncertainty (a context switch). ARC-052's two precision clauses map onto these differently -- forward-model accuracy is expected uncertainty, accumulation volatility is closer to unexpected uncertainty -- so a single shared precision-gain pathway for both harm streams would conflate two quantities this literature says are separately represented.
ARC-052 names serotonin as a precision-gain modulator; this framework does not assign serotonin a role, and the pull found no paper that grounds the serotonergic half of the claim.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Optimal Bayesian inference under unreliable observations in changing contexts requires representing distinct forms of uncertainty; acetylcholine signals expected uncertainty (known unreliability of predictive cues within a context) and norepinephrine signals unexpected uncertainty (unsignalled context switches producing strongly unexpected observations), and these interact to set how strongly observations update beliefs.
mapping.ree_translation: ARC-052's neuromodulatory clause -- that ascending modulators set the precision GAINS rather than the precisions being intrinsic to each encoder. Yu and Dayan supply the computational justification for why a gain channel separate from the encoder is the right factorisation: the quantity a modulator carries is a property of the context, shared across streams, and cannot be recovered from within a single stream's own statistics. Their expected/unexpected split also gives REE a principled reason to route ARC-052's two clauses through different signals rather than one.
mapping.mapping_caveat: This is theory, not measurement: it proposes an assignment consistent with a wealth of existing data rather than testing it. The modulators are ACh and NE; ARC-052 says 5-HT and NE, so only the norepinephrine half is shared, and the pull found nothing grounding the serotonergic half. The framework is also about perceptual/attentional inference in cued tasks, not about an affective harm accumulator, so applying it to z_harm_a is an extension of scope the paper does not make.
mapping.source_context: Computational theory paper synthesising rodent and human physiological, pharmacological and behavioural literature; attentional cueing tasks as the worked example.

confidence_components.notes: Source quality reflects a canonical, heavily cited theory paper -- high for what it is, capped because it contributes no new measurement. Transfer risk is low because the claim being borrowed is architectural (where gains live) rather than a quantitative effect.
